items.title: Essential extensions characterised by non-annihilated multiples
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterizes essential extensions of modules by the existence, for every nonzero element, of a ring element whose multiple is nonzero and lies in the submodule (author lemma at source lines 370-379, label lemma-essential-extension). The proof (source lines 381-389) proves both directions directly through the cyclic submodule generated by an element (proof lines 381-388). The two short implications are the content; the statement and proof are self-contained. H2.
